blocks.h2: Leaks and Old Pipe in Ravenswood
blocks.intro: With nearly half the homes built before 1940, original pipe is common.

items.h3: Galvanized Steel at the End of Its Life
items.body: It rusts inside, cuts pressure and leaks at threaded joints.
In a two-flat, water shows up far from its source.
One leak can be repaired. A failing system is better replaced. If a pipe has burst, see [burst pipe repair](/chicago-ravenswood/burst-pipe-repair).

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.h2: Planning a Repipe in an Older Home
blocks.body: Replacing galvanized supply pipe in an older Ravenswood home doesn't always mean opening every wall. We trace the existing lines, then plan new routes through the basement, closets and plumbing chases. In a two-flat, we can repipe one unit at a time. You'll get a clear plan, a flat price and an idea of which walls, if any, need patching afterward.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a Leak Repair
blocks.body: Finding a leak between floors takes testing. Reaching it may mean opening plaster. Repairing one section is quicker than replacing a run of galvanized pipe. We find it and quote a flat price.

blocks.h2: Leak and Pipe Questions From Ravenswood Homeowners

items.q: Should I replace my galvanized pipe?
items.preview: If it's leaking or pressure is low, it's worth discussing.
items.answer: If you have leaks, rusty water or low pressure, replacing it is worth discussing. We'll show you what we find.

items.q: How do I know if I have galvanized pipe?
items.preview: Gray steel pipe with threaded joints.
items.answer: Look at the pipes near the water heater. Gray steel with threaded fittings is usually galvanized.

items.q: Can you replace pipe without gutting the walls?
items.answer: Often. We route new lines through basements, closets and chases to limit wall openings.
Policies vary. Check with your agent.

items.q: How long does a repipe take?
items.preview: Usually a few days per unit.
items.answer: Usually a few days per unit, depending on access.

items.q: Can you install water leak sensors?
items.answer: Yes, near water heaters, washers and sinks.

items.q: How much does pipe repair cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on the scope. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the leak or how much pipe needs replacing. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
